questions.text: Describe a time when you shared something with other people.
questions.say: Thank you. Now, in Part 2, I'm going to give you a topic, and I'd like you to talk about it for one to two minutes. Before you talk, you'll have one minute to think about what you're going to say. You can make some notes if you wish. Here is your topic. Describe a time when you shared something with other people. You should say: what you shared; who you shared it with; why you shared it; and explain how you felt about sharing it.

questions.text: Did anyone share anything with you in return?
questions.say: Thank you. Did anyone share anything with you in return?

questions.text: Why is it important for children to learn to share?
questions.say: Thank you. We've been talking about a time when you shared something with other people, and I'd like to discuss with you some more general questions related to this. Let's consider first of all sharing. Why is it important for children to learn to share?

questions.text: What kinds of things do people usually not like to share?
